aldiax.d.reto: Teaching people to use AI when it changes every week: the content can't go stale and the points can't be gamed.
aldiax.d.como1: App built with Expo and React Native, using Expo Router and TypeScript.
aldiax.d.como2: Supabase (Postgres) with RLS: each user can only read their own rows.
aldiax.d.como3: The server does the grading: SECURITY DEFINER RPC functions score every answer and the phone only sends it.
aldiax.d.como4: Edge Functions for the AI question generator (the API key never reaches the phone), account deletion and the RevenueCat payments webhook.
aldiax.d.como5: Next.js web admin panel: the AI proposes questions and I approve, edit or discard them before they go live.
aldiax.d.prob1: Anti-farming: each question gives +10 only the first time you get it right. Repeating is for revision, not for inflating your profile.
aldiax.d.prob2: Lives without a cron job: they are recomputed on the fly from a timestamp (one every 4 h; 3 free and 6 with Pro), without giving away or stealing minutes.
aldiax.d.prob3: I closed a paywall hole: deleting and recreating your profile granted lifetime Pro. Now the client can no longer insert or delete profiles.
aldiax.d.prob4: A guilt-free streak with automatic freeze: if it breaks, it's “Let's start again”.
aldiax.d.cifra1: exercise types: multiple choice, matching, ordering and fill in the blank
yunque.d.reto: The whole niche makes its money selling supplements. Yunque sells none, so it can say plainly what works and what doesn't.
yunque.d.como1: Local-first: SQLite and Drizzle on the phone itself. No backend, no accounts, no login.
yunque.d.como2: Basal Index: 28 questions score 6 levers (sleep, body composition, training, nutrition, stress and light, and environment), drawn on a radar chart.
yunque.d.como3: Every method carries an evidence label: solid, promising, speculative, debunked or risky.
yunque.d.como4: Content is data: cards in Markdown and a catalogue of habits.
yunque.d.prob1: Passing Apple's review (guidelines 1.4.1 and 1.4.2): zero numeric promises of hormonal results and no dose calculator.
yunque.d.prob2: Honesty on screen: the result literally says “It doesn't measure your testosterone. It measures how many of the known levers you're using.”
yunque.d.prob3: Streaks and time zones: a habit ticked at 00:30 can't count for the previous day. The tests pin TZ=Europe/Madrid because in UTC the bug would slip through.
yunque.d.prob4: Tests that really protect: I check them by mutation, breaking the code on purpose to see them fail.
yunque.d.cifra2: CI checks on every push: tests, types and the iOS bundle
yunque.d.cifra4: servers: everything lives on the phone
chatadn.d.func1: In WhatsApp you export the chat “without media” and open the .txt or .zip file in ChatADN.
chatadn.d.func2: The app recognises the export format and works out the numbers: messages, participants, active days, reply times, words and emojis.
chatadn.d.func3: The result is told as a story, screen by screen, with cards to share.
chatadn.d.privacidad: The analysis runs entirely on the phone, with no servers. It stores the statistics, never the text of the chat.
neurona.d.idea: A game for get-togethers where everyone plays on their own phone and, at the end, you find out who the dumbest in the group is.
neurona.d.como1: Monorepo with Expo and React Native.
neurona.d.como2: Rooms sync in real time with Supabase, for up to 8 players at once.
